No notifications sent.

legacy.name: one root groups home, stock and account evidence without losing individual facts or restrictions
repeated observations and process restart retain reservation and never schedule the same event twice
severity escalation is a distinct event, separates critical notices and bypasses ordinary cooldown
explicit usable resolution closes the incident, missing and stale evidence cannot call it safe
an absent root in a complete observation records a gap and keeps site restrictions
partial observations preserve unrelated roots and account resets cannot reuse old reservations
gateway acceptance is not receiver delivery; user viewing is distinct from transport evidence
refreshing only the source clock keeps a viewed incident viewed while escalation creates unread evidence
nested original plan and order references survive grouping and cannot become trading authority
receiver confirmation needs exact retained reservation and a trusted timed receipt, and cannot be downgraded
unknown results and contradictory gateway receipts retain the single reservation
root and class mute affect only notification, retain site risks and require current authorized-user revision
cooldown, daily cap and superseded lifecycle events make oscillating alerts bounded
ordinary cooldown reasons persist through restart without creating a delivery or suppressing severe escalation
future or missing source time cannot resolve a root and duplicate IDs are rejected
old sender result normalization requires affirmative gateway evidence and never invents receiver proof
root and category mute keep separate evidence so clearing one scope cannot claim to unmute the other

excludedLegacy: real process concurrency, filesystem corruption/symlink, original private sender and queue tests; not executed
